description.en: Joins two spreadsheets on a declared key and compares declared fields within declared tolerances, producing a Markdown report, a JSON result and a diff workbook; it reports differences rather than adjudicating them.
description.zh: 按声明的主键连接两张表，按声明字段与容差比对，输出 Markdown 报告、JSON 结果与差异工作簿；只报告差异，不裁决对错。
